contents.text: How should an HG-400 be stored for more than six months?
For storage longer than six months, fill the gearbox completely with oil. The oil level should be checked weekly. The oil should be changed as specified in the maintenance schedule.

HG-400 Helical Gearbox Operating Manual › 3 Installation › 3.1 Transport and storage
# 3 Installation
## 3.1 Transport and storage
Store the gearbox indoors in a dry place.
For storage longer than six months, fill it completely with oil and turn the input shaft by hand every month, so that the bearings and gear teeth stay coated.

Field service report SR-2026-1213
Engineer: Kwame Asante.
Date: December 13, 2026.
Complaint: a whining noise from the HG-400 gearbox that rose with speed.
Findings: the oil level was below the sight glass and the oil had darkened; the last oil change was 14 months earlier.
Work done: drained and flushed the gearbox, refilled it with 18 liters of ISO VG 220 oil and replaced a leaking output shaft seal.
The noise dropped to normal.
Recommended an oil analysis every six months.
| Equipment | Site | Report |
|---|---|---|
| HG-400 gearbox | Woodgrove Foods, Packaging line 2 | SR-2026-1213 |

HG-400 Helical Gearbox Operating Manual › 4 Lubrication › 4.1 Lubrication
# 4 Lubrication
## 4.1 Lubrication
The HG-400 is filled at the factory with 18 liters of ISO VG 220 mineral gear oil.
Change the oil after the first 500 operating hours, then every 5,000 operating hours or every 12 months, whichever comes first.
Synthetic PAO oil of the same viscosity extends the interval to 10,000 hours.
In operation, the oil temperature must not exceed 90 °C.

HG-400 Helical Gearbox Operating Manual › 6 Maintenance
# 6 Maintenance
Table 6-1 Maintenance schedule
| Task | Interval |
|---|---|
| Check the oil level at the sight glass | Weekly |
| Check for leaks and unusual noise | Weekly |
| Clean the cooling fins | Every 3 months |
| Oil analysis for viscosity, water and metal particles | Every 6 months |
| Change the oil | As Table 4-1 |
| Replace the shaft seals | Every 20,000 h or when leaking |
